summary: Retested the home visit tracking fix in real Chromium with CSP enforced (no bypass_csp). Everything passes. (1) A fresh context on /inicio.html sends POST /api/track/access, which returns 200 with no CSP violation for that request, and a new entry with page /inicio.html shows up in GET /api/admin/accesses for the localStorage visitor_id. (2) Opening /inicio.html and immediately clicking the Edital 25 link to go to /edital-25.html still sends the request and records /inicio.html (keepalive works). (3) Opening /termos-concurso.html, /edital-24.html and /edital-25.html directly in fresh contexts sends 0 track requests and adds 0 new access entries. (4) On /termos-concurso.html the page loader turns on (class 'on') and navigation works for the nav 'Início' link, the VOLTAR button (to /inicio.html) and CONTINUAR after checking the terms box (to /inscricao.html?c=porto-velho_concurso). No JS page errors. Backend regression tests: 3/3 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Harmless console noise: the inicio.html CSP (script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:) blocks Cloudflare's injected beacon.min.js and challenge-platform scripts. This does not affect tracking. Only relevant if Cloudflare analytics or challenges are wanted on the home page.
termos-concurso.html has no CSP meta, unlike the other pages. That is fine now that it has no tracking script.
seed_data_creation: 2 real /inicio.html access entries were added by the browser tests (visitor_ids v_mwdtitpl_1j9163gq and v_mwdtiwkf_ipneuw2m) and 1 TEST_ visitor from pytest. They cannot be removed because there is no delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home tracking works under CSP. To verify, open fresh contexts, listen for requests to track/access, and match entries in GET /api/admin/accesses?limit=50 by the localStorage visitor_id. On termos-concurso, use the visible elements (#btn-voltar-termos, #bt-continuar after checking #termos, a.btn-ghost[href='/inicio.html']). The first a[href='/inscricao.html'] is hidden.
